name: 1. Buka & Auto-RUN Standar (tanpa Kamera)
description: Menjalankan ExamBrowser standar untuk ujian ANBK/CBT

name: 2. Tutup Aman ExamBrowser (Ctrl+C+B)
description: Menutup aplikasi ujian ExamBrowser secara aman
code:
Stop-Process -Name ExamBrowser, ExamBrowserAdmin, exambrowser -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "ExamBrowser berhasil ditutup."

name: 3. Buka & Auto-RUN Kamera Aktif
description: Menjalankan aplikasi ujian dengan proctoring kamera aktif
code:
Start-Process "C:\ExamBrowser\ExamBrowser.exe" -ArgumentList "--enable-camera" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "ExamBrowser Kamera Aktif dijalankan."

name: 4. Bersihkan Cache & Temp File
description: Membersihkan file sementara, cache Windows, dan Recycle Bin
code:
Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "File sampah & cache berhasil dibersihkan."

name: 5. Tes Latensi & Koneksi Internet Lab
description: Melakukan uji ping ke DNS Google untuk cek kestabilan koneksi
